'''AC-21''' was a sector in the [[Euclidean Complex]] in [[Rotkan]]. Visitors to the Euclidean Complex had to have visas stamped on their [[Intergalactic Passport]]s in order to enter Rotkan and were to be accompanied by guides at all times. In addition, all visitors' belongings will be confiscated during this time.
